# Nivi Arts

> Artist-led sip-and-paint nights, private parties, corporate workshops, and weekend art classes at the Nivi Arts studio in West Windsor, New Jersey.

Every experience is taught personally by Nivi at her West Windsor studio. Weekend workshops rotate through six class types and are booked through a live Google Calendar; private parties, corporate workshops, and sip-and-paint nights are arranged by request.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Nivi Arts, weekend classes, and studio experiences.
- [Weekend Classes](/classes): The six workshop types and the month-by-month class calendar.
- [Services](/services): Private parties, corporate workshops, and sip-and-paint (wine) nights.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Finished pieces and photos from recent workshops and events.
- [Book](/book): Live booking calendar for this month's weekend workshops.
- [Contact](/contact): Enquiries for private parties, corporate workshops, and partnerships.
